# Oakville HVAC Pros

> Oakville HVAC Pros is an Ontario heating and cooling contractor based in Oakville. Homeowners call the team for furnace and air conditioner repair, heat pump and ductless installation, fireplace service, smart thermostat setup, and full-system duct cleaning across Halton Region.

Phone: (905) 845-3072  |  Email: contact@oakvillehvacpros.ca  |  Website: https://oakvillehvacpros.ca

Service areas: Oakville, Burlington, Milton, Georgetown, Acton, Ajax, Pickering, Whitby
